149.news_title: Special Pre-Order Bonuses on our 26 and 35 inch 4:3 Arcade monitors!
149.long_description: For a limited time only, purchase a 26-inch 4:3 LCD monitor or our 35-inch 4:3 LCD monitor for a substantial pre-order bonus! Order and pay for the monitor with a decent discount as well as free bonus items before the 31st of March 2025. Once expired, monitor prices will return to their original prices. 26-Inch 4:3 Ratio Arcade LCD Monitor This is a professional 26-inch monitor designed for all arcade machines and retro game enthusiasts and a direct replacement for CRT Tube Monitors. The 26" arcade LCD panel offers a 4:3 viewing ratio with RGB, VGA and HDMI input and supports 15khz 24khz 31khz and high definition up to 1600 x 1200 UXGA resolution. 35-Inch 4:3 Ratio Arcade LCD Monitor The 35-inch monitor is our largest 4:3 resolution Arcooda LCD arcade monitor, making it perfect to replace your CRT tube or rear projection arcade monitors. It supports native 15khz, 24khz and 31khz arcade games as well as offering the ability to run the latest arcade games in high definition. For both of these products, the following pre-order bonuses are available: - RGB to VGA Adapter Board for Jamma Wiring - Monitor Adjustment Board 1.6m Extension Cable - LCD OSD Monitor Adjustment Board - $100 discount To receive the bonus, full payment is needed by 31st of March 2025, with the estimated delivery date being the 28th of April 2025.
